newsitem.title: FINLAND: Construction, industry fuel Finnish Dec GDP growth.
newsitem.headline: Construction, industry fuel Finnish Dec GDP growth.

text.p: Construction rose almost 16 percent and seasonally adjusted industrial production increased nearly nine percent, boosting the pace of Finnish GDP growth to 6.2 percent in December, Statistics Finland (SF) said on Friday.
The December growth rate was the fastest in any month last year, SF said. GDP rose 6.1 percent in October and 4.4 percent in November. SF earlier said 1996 GDP rose 3.2 percent yr/yr.
Output in the transport and communications sector rose over eight percent in December. Trade sector output rose 3.5 percent and other services and public sector output rose three percent.
Adjusted for seasonal factors, GDP rose 0.4 percent in December on November, SF said.
